Erweiterungen von anderen Entwicklern fü: Extensions from other developers add file formats, QA checks and commands. An extension is program code and runs with your permissions – only install and enable extensions from trusted sources. Newly installed extensions are disabled at first.
Die Erweiterung erhält vollen Zugriff au: The extension gets full access to your projects, files and the network – with your user permissions. Sententiam converte does not check third-party code. Only enable it if you trust the publisher.
Eingeschaltete Erweiterungen zeigen hier: Enabled extensions show their commands here.
Eine Erweiterung ist eine .NET-10-Biblio: An extension is a .NET 10 library that is compiled against SententiamConverte.Core and contains a public class implementing the IExtension interface. In Register() it declares what it contributes: AddFileFilter (IFileFilter – read and write back a new file format), AddQaCheck (IQaCheck – custom check per segment) and AddCommand (IExtensionCommand – command for a segment, document, project or general use; it receives the project, file, document, segment and arguments as well as the configured language model and web search). The package includes an extension.json with id, name, version, author, description and assembly. Pack the library and extension.json as a ZIP file with the extension .scext. A complete template is in the source code under Erweiterungen/Beispiel.Erweiterung – “dotnet build” creates the finished package there. Commands can also be called via the REST API: POST /api/v2/extensions/commands/{id}.
Der Agent sucht zum Thema in jeder gewäh: The agent searches for reliable sources on the topic in each selected language, reads them and creates knowledge entries with verbatim evidence in the knowledge base selected above. Entries whose evidence does not actually appear on the page are discarded. Pages that prohibit automated reading via robots.txt or a reservation of rights are skipped.
